column1: # Lamakan finale: Ash Jenna's reveal, the echoes, the choice and three endings.

column3: You came back. I wondered\nif you would.{end_wait}
You watched us in the sand.\nYou knew what happened.\nWho are you?{end_wait}
You kept walking, so you\nhave earned an answer. I'll\ntell you what I am.{end_wait}
You aren't our Jenna. So\nwho are you?{end_wait}

I am a Jenna from a world
the Wise One burned.{page_break}I'm the one he couldn't
kill. The fire I took from
his ruin belongs to me now.{end_wait}
Then what do you want from\nus? From Isaac?{end_wait}

Your lighthouses are doors.
Each one wakes the sleepers
and feeds the flame.{page_break}Kill the awakened and the
door will close, quickly
and cleanly. Just choose.{end_wait}
She's telling the truth,\nIsaac, and she's afraid.\nI can hear it in her.{end_wait}
If there is another way,\nwe have to find it. I won't\nlet fear choose for us.{end_wait}
You stayed with that miner\nuntil the end. I saw you.{end_wait}
You opened that door. I can\nstill hear her humming.{end_wait}
You tried to reach them,\neven when you knew they\nmight not hear you.{end_wait}
You showed no mercy at all,\nIsaac. You and I are\nalready the same.{end_wait}
Take her offer?{end_now}
All right. Do it, and make\nit quick.{end_wait}
Good. Close your eyes,\nIsaac. It will be faster\nthat way.{end_wait}
They've all gone quiet.\nIsaac, what did you do?{end_wait}
He did what I asked.\nWelcome, Isaac.{end_wait}
No. We'll find another\nway, and I'll carry\nwhatever it costs.{end_wait}
Then carry it. The sleepers\nwill still wake, and\nremember that I offered.{end_wait}
I'll hear every one of\nthem, Isaac, but I'm\nstaying with you.{end_wait}
Then we keep looking. I\nwon't pretend this is easy.\nBut the choice is ours.{end_wait}
I won't do that, not even\nto stop all of this.{end_wait}
Then I'll wait. People like\nyou always come around in\nthe end.{end_wait}
I can't keep waiting for\na way that never comes.\nI'll act alone, if I must.{end_wait}
Mia, don't do this! Please\ncome back!{end_wait}

Your Jenna, Kraden and
Felix are still Menardi's
prisoners.{page_break}The Wise One has noticed
you now, so hurry to Kalay.{end_wait}
